title: Two Barcodes on Your Book Cover? How to Fix a Duplicate or Missing ISBN Barcode | SparkPrep
h1: How to fix a duplicate or missing barcode on your back cover
description: Your cover has a barcode and the printer added another, or there's none at all. Learn where the barcode goes and how to avoid printing two.
lead: One barcode belongs on the back cover. Too many authors end up with two, or none.
error: Cover has a barcode in the barcode area, or no barcode where one is needed
errorNote: Paraphrased. This comes up as a proof problem or a cover review note rather than one fixed message.
why:
Amazon KDP can place a barcode for you on the back cover. If your designer already put one in and you don't tell KDP your cover includes a barcode, you can end up with a second one printed over your art. KDP's barcode area is 2" x 1.2" in the lower right of the back cover.

IngramSpark needs a barcode on the back cover too. Its barcode area is 1.75" x 1". If your file has none, or it doesn't match your ISBN, the cover is rejected.
manual: Decide who adds the barcode: you (in your cover file) or your printer.
If it's in your file, make sure it encodes your book's exact ISBN and sits in the back cover's lower right, inside the safe area.
Keep that barcode area clear of text and busy art.
On KDP, tick that your cover already includes a barcode if it does, so it isn't added twice.
Re-upload the cover and check the printer's preview or proof for exactly one barcode.
quickfix: SparkPrep makes your barcode from your ISBN and places it in your printer's barcode area. If your art already has one, it leaves it alone.
spNote: SparkPrep also reads the ISBN printed on your cover and flags it if it doesn't match your book.

cta.text: Enter your ISBN and SparkPrep adds one barcode in the right spot for your printer, or skips it if your art already has one.

faq.q: Does KDP add a barcode for me?
faq.a: KDP can place one on the back cover. If your cover already has a barcode, tell KDP so it doesn't add a second.

faq.q: How big is the barcode area?
faq.a: 2" x 1.2" on KDP and 1.75" x 1" on IngramSpark, in the lower right of the back cover.
